A digital device operates with discrete values, typically binary (on/off, 1/0).  
- (A) Regulator of a fan — usually analog (continuous voltage control).  
- (B) Microphone — analog sensor (continuous sound waves to continuous electrical signals).  
- (C) Resistance of a material — analog property.  
- (D) Light switch — simplest digital device (on or off state, no intermediate values).  

Final answer: (D)
